name: Didi Caldwell
jobTitle: Board Chair — Founder & President, Global Location Strategies; Founder & Board Chair, Strata Platforms

photo.alt: Portrait of Didi Caldwell, Board Chair

quote: Investment readiness is a journey. All sites are somewhere along that journey, and the objective of the economic developer should be to move their sites along that journey towards a state of full readiness. The REDI Sites program is a road map that shows you where you are on that journey and what you need to move closer and closer to the final destination. It doesn't all have to be done at once, and sometimes little improvements can mean a lot. The point is to just keep moving along the path.

name: Gregg Wassmansdorf
jobTitle: Treasurer — Senior Managing Director, Global Strategy, Newmark
quote: The REDI Sites program addresses the following two common problems, among others. First, for landowners and project proponents, they don't typically have a clear set of guidelines to begin the process of evaluating their own site and taking steps to make it more investment ready. Second, for companies, investors, and site selectors, the site readiness programs that exist across the country have wildly different requirements to earn a stamp, receive a credential, or be added to a site database, which makes site comparisons across jurisdictions very difficult. The REDI Sites program provides a clear path toward improved site readiness and provides a consistent methodology to evaluate site opportunities.

name: Jeannette Goldsmith
jobTitle: Board Member — President, Strategic Development Group

photo.alt: Portrait of a REDI Sites team member

quote: What sets REDI Sites apart is that it was developed by site selection professionals to provide a consistent, national perspective on site readiness. That consistency is particularly valuable because the evaluation reflects the perspective of the professionals who work with companies every day to identify and evaluate locations for significant projects. Another important differentiator is that REDI is industry- and use-agnostic. That makes the evaluation relevant across a broad range of potential projects and allows site selectors to quickly understand a property's strengths, limitations, and remaining risks.

quote: Speed to market is an overused cliché, but it still rings true – site readiness is a ticket to enter the economic development game. We have clients who have consistently invested in site prep for 10+ years until finally getting a win. Economic development is a game of persistence and endurance, and success favors those who put in the work over the long term.
